points.description: States that elements are popped from the original stack and stored/pushed onto another (auxiliary) stack, one by one, while searching (checking each popped element against the target).
points.partial_credit: Half (1 mark) if pop is stated but the second/temporary stack is not mentioned, or another stack is used without saying elements are popped one at a time while checking.

points.description: States that this popping continues until the required element is found (search stops at the target).
States that after the element is found, all the elements from the other stack are pushed back onto the original stack, restoring its original order/contents.
points.partial_credit: Half (1 mark) if push back is mentioned but the destination (original stack) or restoration is unclear.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the precise operations named: pop to a second stack until the element is found, then push everything back onto the original stack. Part marks only when clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Vague answers (e.g. "traverse the stack", "search through it"), use of an array/queue instead of a stack, or wrong operations earn nothing for that point.
